text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Spring... Our spring has finally arrived. 
It all starts from here."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —The whole year the two of us shared!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan, first up is the Osaka Hai, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll take the lead and run first. 
And next up is Dia-chan's Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Let's build upon this from here on out. 
Heading toward year-end—and the Arima 
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san...! There's a rumor like 
this going around on Umatter!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
“Is Kitasan Black okay with this 
distance?” “Compared to the Kikuka Sho or 
the Arima Kinen, isn't 2000m at the Osaka 
Hai way too short?” they wonder.

True, the distance is shorter compared to 
the string of races at the end of last 
year, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
choice_data_list:
Before the Kikuka Sho, they told you it 
was too long, right?

Before the Kikuka Sho, people said it was 
too long, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right, isn't it? I've been told 
the exact opposite all this time...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... In the end, if people are gonna 
talk no matter how hard I try, there's no 
point in worrying about it too much, 
right?

There was no longer any need to worry 
about what the public thought. We now had 
the track record and trust to blow all of 
that away.
choice_data_list:
Go out there and prove what you're capable 
of!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm off! Whether it's 1,000, 2,000, 
or 3,000 meters, I'm just gonna do what I 
have to do!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Watch me, Dia-chan. First, my debut 
race—!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
To build some momentum and celebrate a 
fresh start for the two of us, I'll show 
you an amazing run!
